title: Law to send traffic complaints to NYPD's Transportation Bureau
summary: This bill would require the 311 system to route non-emergency traffic complaints, such as drag racing, chronic speeding, congestion and truck route violations, directly to the NYPD's Transportation Bureau instead of local precincts. The Council found that 1,496 traffic-related service requests since 2021 were closed as being outside an agency's jurisdiction. The law would take effect 90 days after enactment.
